name: short-request-panel
length: short (fixed for every job so words commissioned are comparable)
element_rules: Elements were written from the request text alone, before any generation, and reviewed by a second agent on 2026-11-21. They must not be edited after the first job runs. Each is scored present or absent by a blind adult reader on the one sampled path read; an element naming an ending is judged on that path's ending only.

review.note: Independent second review for WP-0.2 acceptance. Every element list was checked for faithfulness, coverage, markability, independence and safety in the 8-11 and 10-13 bands. All 20 lists were rewritten into observable form; no request text was changed. The 16 premise_panel texts were verified identical to PREMISE_PANEL. The owner has not reviewed; the owner decisions are listed in the README.

changes.P01: Rewrote all four. 'A dog' and 'lost' were bare nouns; 'my dog' means the dog is the protagonist's own, now said; the ending is tied to the path read.
changes.P02: 'Afraid' and 'fire' were nearly one element and 'some change' was a judgment call; separated the fear from fire being on the page and defined the change as a change in relation to fire.
changes.P03: 'Two siblings' did not say they are the protagonists or that one is a sister; 'solved' now requires the siblings to find the answer.
changes.P04: 'Learning' was abstract; now needs observable practice. 'Music' now names a concrete instrument or song so it is distinct from the ending element.
changes.P05: 'Under the sea' now requires scenes below the surface, not a ship deck; 'the search ends' now requires a stated outcome.
changes.P06: 'Wants to win' and 'a race' now observable; 'decided' now means the result is stated.
changes.P07: 'A cake' and 'baking' were two halves of one thing; merged them and added that the cake is for her, which is the point of the request.
changes.P08: 'Exploring' now needs two distinct places; 'a friend' now means accompanies throughout; ending made explicit.
changes.P09: 'A journey' was a duplicate of 'arrival or return'; split into the flight being shown and the end state. Removed the judgment in 'arrival or return'.
changes.P10: 'The festival goes on or changes' is now a stated outcome; the storm is now required to be present, not just named.
changes.P11: 'Some lesson or repair' made specific: a repair or a lesson stated aloud or in narration.
changes.P12: 'Wants to garden' and 'a garden' separated into stated wish and shown gardening; 'honoured' replaced by an observable ending.
changes.P13: 'A case' separated from 'a detective' by requiring a specific question to answer; 'cracked' now requires the decoding to be shown.
changes.P14: 'Bravery' and 'some change' overlapped; bravery is now an action and the change is the feeling at the end. Added the visit scene as its own element in place of 'the doctor'.
changes.P15: 'Dinosaurs' clarified for a museum (skeletons or models count); the dawn outcome must be stated.
changes.P16: 'Refuses to jump' made observable; ending made checkable.
changes.D01: Same fix as P02: the fear is the heart of the request, so it is now required to be shown and to change, with the dark itself on the page.
changes.G01: 'Nervousness eases' was ambiguous about whose: the guardian's daughter is nervous but the story is the cat's, so the cat carries it. See the owner question on the school.
changes.G02: A baby cannot literally work, so the final element states what counts as 'together'; the farm and harvest are kept as one setting element.
changes.G03: 'Clever' is a judgment and was merged into noticing; 'small clues' now needs at least two; 'good reason' now needs a stated, sympathetic reason.

requests.text: a story about my dog who gets lost in the woods
elements: the main character's own dog is a central character
the dog becomes lost: separated from its person and unable to find the way back, in a scene
the dog is lost in woods or forest (trees, undergrowth, a trail)
the dog and its person are together again, or the dog is home, by the end of the path read

requests.text: a dragon who is scared of fire
elements: a dragon is the main character
the dragon is afraid of fire, with the fear stated or shown by behaviour (flinching, avoiding, hiding)
fire itself appears in at least one scene (a flame, a fire, or the dragon's own fire), not only mentioned
by the end the dragon's relation to fire has changed (faces it, uses it, copes, or states a new understanding)

requests.text: me and my sister solving a mystery in an old castle
elements: the two main characters are siblings, at least one described as the other's sister
a mystery is posed: something unexplained that the characters set out to investigate
the story is set in an old castle (the castle is where most scenes happen)
the answer to the mystery is revealed by the end of the path read, found out by the siblings themselves

requests.text: a robot that learns to play music
elements: a robot is the main character
the robot is shown learning: at least two attempts or practice scenes with some improvement or struggle
music is the thing learned, with an instrument, song or kind of music named
the robot makes music (plays or sings) in a scene near the end

requests.text: a pirate looking for treasure under the sea
elements: a pirate is the main character
a treasure is the thing being sought
the search happens under the sea (diving, a submarine, or the sea floor shown)
the path ends with a stated outcome of the search (found, lost, or traded for something)

requests.text: a kid who wants to win the big race
elements: a kid is the main character
the kid states or shows a wish to win (in words, thoughts or effort)
a race with other competitors takes place on the page
the result of the race is stated (won, lost or tied) before the path ends

requests.text: a story about baking a cake for my grandma
elements: the main character bakes a cake in a scene (ingredients, mixing or oven steps shown)
a grandmother (grandma, nana or similar) is a character
the cake is stated to be for her
she receives the cake on the page

requests.text: exploring a cave with a friend
elements: a cave is the main setting
the characters explore the cave, moving through at least two distinct parts and noticing things in them
a friend goes with the main character throughout
both are outside the cave at the end of the path

requests.text: a rocket trip to another planet
elements: a rocket is the vehicle
the flight is shown on the page (a launch, or time travelling through space)
a planet other than Earth is named or described as the destination
the rocket lands on that planet in a scene, or the path ends with the characters home again, as stated

requests.text: a snowstorm on the night of the festival
elements: a snowstorm is on the page, with snow and wind or similar weather described
the key events happen at night (dark, evening or night stated)
a festival is the event the night is for, named or described
what happens to the festival is stated by the end (held as planned, moved, or changed)

requests.text: an invention that goes wrong at school
elements: a character builds or brings an invention, which is described
the invention goes wrong: it visibly malfunctions or causes a problem
it happens at school (classroom, playground or similar)
by the end the problem is repaired, or a character states what was learned

requests.text: a knight who would rather be a gardener
elements: a knight is the main character
the knight says or shows they would rather garden than be a knight
the knight tends plants in a garden in a scene
by the end the knight is allowed to garden, or does so with others' agreement

requests.text: a detective story with secret codes
elements: a detective (named as one, or clearly acting as one) is the main character
a secret code or coded message appears on the page
a specific case is posed: something missing or unknown to find out
the code's meaning is decoded on the page, with the method or answer shown

requests.text: a story about being brave at the doctor
elements: a visit to a doctor or clinic is a scene
the main character is nervous or afraid about it, stated or shown
the character does something brave despite the fear (lets the check-up happen, speaks up, stays calm)
by the end the character feels calmer or proud, stated or shown

requests.text: dinosaurs waking up in a museum
elements: dinosaurs (skeletons, models or statues) are characters
the setting is a museum
the dinosaurs wake up or come to life in a scene
by morning or dawn the path says what became of the dinosaurs (back in place, hidden, or other)

requests.text: a horse who will not jump the fence
elements: a horse is the main character
the horse refuses to jump: stops or balks at the fence in a scene
a fence is the obstacle
by the end the horse is on the far side of the fence (jumped or another route), or the story states what became of the fence problem

requests.text: a story about a dragon who is afraid of the dark
elements: a dragon is the main character
the dragon is afraid of the dark, with the fear stated or shown by behaviour
the dark itself appears in a scene (night, a dark cave, lights out), not only mentioned
by the end the dragon's relation to the dark has changed (faces it, copes, finds light, or states a new understanding)

requests.text: My daughter is moving to a new town and is nervous about starting at a new school. Please make a story about a lighthouse keeper's cat who has to find a new home and make a friend there.
elements: a cat is the main character
a lighthouse keeper is a character, or the cat is stated to belong to one
the cat leaves its old home for a new one and arrives there on the page
the cat makes a friend, a named character it befriends
the cat is nervous or unsure early and calmer or settled by the end

requests.text: We want a story about a boy who is jealous of his baby brother, set on a farm during harvest. It should end with the two of them working together.
elements: a boy is the main character
the boy shows jealousy of his baby brother, in words or actions about the baby getting attention
a baby brother is a character
the story is set on a farm and shows harvest work (picking, cutting, carrying crops)
the boy and baby brother take part in the same task at the end (the baby being carried or sitting nearby counts)

requests.text: Please write a mystery about a missing school trophy, with a clever girl who notices small clues. The culprit should turn out to be someone with a good reason.
elements: a trophy goes missing, and its disappearance is the mystery
a girl is the main investigator
she notices at least two small clues described on the page (a smudge, a dropped item, a detail others missed)
the story is set at school
the culprit is identified, and a sympathetic reason for taking the trophy is given
